_note: logoUrl: an SVG or hosted image URL for the top-right of the PDF. Must be CORS-accessible (hosting it in this repo / jsDelivr works). SVGs need an intrinsic width/height. Leave empty for no logo. logoBox = max width/height in mm; the image is fitted preserving aspect ratio.
_features_note: features.pdfSavePrompt.companyIds is a whitelist of HireHop numeric user.COMPANY_IDs that get the local Save-As prompt when they Add a stage kit. All other companies still get the PDF auto-uploaded to the Files tab but skip the interactive save dialog. Empty list = feature off for everyone.
